title: Beckley PD celebrates Safety in the Community week - NewsBreak
text: BECKLEY, WV (WVNS) — Walmart is celebrating its Safety Week and invited the Beckley Police Department to be a part of it. Patrolman First Class Adam Justice spent some time outside of the Walmart on Eisenhower Drive talking with the community and offering information and car seat safety inspections to whoever was interested. He said that doing events like this is also an important part of his job. “Just to outreach to the community, just to let them know that we’re here, not just to do law enforcement stuff, but that we’re here for the community. Just to hand out stuff to the kids, to get them a positive experience with law enforcement,” said Justice. Justice said he had dozens of people come up to talk and get various kinds of information from him. He said the kids he saw really enjoyed the free snacks, coloring books, and plastic Beckley Police Department badges he was giving out.
